steps.step: start
ctrl-x ctrl-p hides the lane
ctrl-x ctrl-p shows the lane again
ctrl-x ctrl-o opens the palette
typing a query with no match shows the empty state
a matching query narrows the list
Esc closes the palette
@ opens the mention completions
clearing the draft closes the completions
the effort trigger opens its menu above itself
picking a level writes it into the trigger
the agent-type trigger opens its menu
picking an agent type writes it into the lane
